Header Cell at 18pt
This is the main heading for the section with adequate font size for readability

Medium Cell at 10pt
This cell uses a moderate font size, close to the minimum

Small Cell at 8pt
A very small font size below the 9pt minimum threshold

Dense text at 8pt, multiple lines
Line 2: Metric trend over time
Line 3: Target achievement at 95%

Normal text at 12pt
A comfortable reading size on screen

Tiny text at 7pt
Too small for practical use; flagged by quality checks

Large narrative block at 10pt with extensive content
This paragraph packs a lot of text into one shape grid cell so that it wraps several times, the kind of density the eval harness needs to detect.

Acceptable at 9pt
Right at the threshold. Should not trigger font size warnings.

Mixed sizes would go here
In practice, cells can't mix sizes in shape_grid
But this tests the boundary at 11pt
